answer: Randomized Anchor Reveal. At each dawn, the protocol derives a seed from a public verifiable random function and uses it to select, per agent identity, one hidden anchor record from a large committed set. Agents must reveal that record within a short window or lose standing. An attacker cannot precompute which anchor will be demanded, since the seed is unknowable until the round opens. Each fake identity therefore requires maintaining a full, distinct set of valid anchor records and the velvet-proof storage to answer unpredictable challenges,
